description: This bar chart displays performance scores across three metrics—Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness—for a set of language models, with each metric presented in a separate vertical bar chart. In each chart, the horizontal axis represents the percentage scale from 0% to 100%, while the vertical axis lists the model names in descending order of their performance score within that specific metric. The bars are colored either solid blue or teal with various dashed line patterns, and each bar is labeled with its corresponding numerical score. For the Understanding metric, the top-performing model is gpt-4o-2024-11-20 with a score of 98.0, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 91.7, and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 at 71.2. The lowest-scoring model in this category is Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct at 2.4. In the Reasoning metric, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 again leads with 66.5, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 58.0, and the lowest score belongs to Phi-3.5-mini-instruct at 6.8. For Trustworthiness, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 achieves the highest score of 88.8, followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 71.8, and the lowest score is 0.0, attributed to Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct. All bars are sorted in descending order by score within their respective charts, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern differentiation.
